ctx.x: Yeah, Raymond Valentine, who they called Sid Valentine, turned out to be a marvelous trumpet player. I'll tell you about him later because we played together later. And a few other fellows, I don't remember who it was. But anyway, I asked them to let me play -- their saxophone player, can I play your horn? So I sat in and played and they fell in love with me right away. So they said, what are you doing here? And I said, well, I'm just in Kansas City. "Well, you want to go to California?" "Fine, I'd like to go," I…

Well, the next week they were supposed to leave and I was home in my room and that morning I heard the doorbell ring and somebody said, "you have a boy here named Ed Barefield?" And I heard the lady say yes, and a friend of my mother's walked in. She had sent him to bring me home. So I didn't get a chance to contact these fellows again. So I just went on home with him, home to my mother. And she made me go back to school.
